name: Stuffed snails
summary: Snails stuffed with meat, the plate Visit Lâm Đồng calls the specialty at one Hai Bà Trưng door.
origin: Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note calls ốc nhồi thịt the specialty at 33 Hai Bà Trưng.
howToEat: The note names the dish and does not describe the stuffing. The same door’s menu also has meat, fish, chicken, and squid, without naming those plates.
where: 33 Hai Bà Trưng. Hours are Check on arrival.
